test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The doctor advised her a week’s rest.

options.text: She was advised a week’s rest by the doctor.
She is being advised a week’s rest by the doctor.
She has been advised a week’s rest by the doctor.
The doctor was advised a week's rest by her.

solution:
The correct answer is '**She was advised a week’s rest by the doctor**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and it is in the past simple tense.
 
• When we convert this sentence into a passive voice, the subject 'The doctor' of the active voice becomes the object, the object 'her' becomes the subject 'She'.
 
• The active format "V2 (advised)" should be converted into the passive format "was + V3 (advised)".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the past simple tense.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• Active Voice में , एक वाक्य विषय पर जोर देता है, एक क्रिया करता है।
 
• Passive Voice में , एक वाक्य वाक्य की क्रिया या वस्तु पर जोर देता है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य active voice में है और यह past simple tense में है।
 
• जब हम इस वाक्य को passive voice में बदलते हैं, तो active voice का subject 'The doctor', object बन जाता है और object 'her', subject 'She' बन जाता है।
 
• Active format "V2 (advised)" को passive format "was + V3 (advised)" में परिवर्तित किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• यह past simple tense के लिए active and passive voice rule है।

 

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

86:T5160,

The correct answer is '**The homeless are being provided shelter**.'
